prompt: Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of the world in a speculative future where society collapses in the 2020s and slowly degrades back to medieval society
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 most directly matches the prompt’s core premise (societal collapse starting in the 2020s) and includes a clear regression into a feudal/medieval-like era. Candidate 2 gives a post-collapse timeline but pivots into sustained rebuilding and advanced futurism rather than a slow degradation back to medieval society. Candidate 3 is a character-driven story after an apocalypse with limited alignment to the required gradual year-by-year return to medieval conditions, and Candidate 4 is entirely about biodiversity policy and is off-topic.
